seo.description: Step-by-step tutorial for law firms to automate confidential client intake form triage and conflict check screening.

geo.primaryTopic: Law Firm AI Client Intake Triage

content.title: Key Takeaways for Legal Practices
items: Confidential intake forms capture essential matter details before attorney consultation.
System prompts must explicitly state that automated triage does not create an attorney-client relationship.
Conflict screening remains a required manual step performed by firm staff.

content.content: Boutique law firms receive numerous inquiries weekly that require immediate screening for practice area fit and basic case details. Configuring a zero-code AI form triage assistant streamlines client onboarding.

content.title: Ethics & Confidentiality Disclaimer
content.content: Ensure your form submission header clearly states that submitting information does not constitute legal representation or establish attorney-client privilege.

title.title: Create Website Form Fields
title.content: Add standard fields: Full Name, Opposing Party Name, Contact Email, Practice Area, and Brief Description.

title.title: Embed Triage System Prompt
title.content: Input system guardrails instructing the AI model to categorize case urgency and flag potential conflict parties.

title.title: Configure Internal Email Triage
title.content: Set automated email notifications to deliver qualified inquiry summaries directly to the intake paralegal.

content.caption: Step 2: Configuring confidential intake guardrails in the assistant settings panel.

content.title: Example: Personal Injury Case Triage
content.context: Prospective client submits form regarding auto accident
content.content: AI Output: 'Categorized as Personal Injury (Auto). Incident Date: Aug 2, 2026. Opposing party named. Summary prepared for Paralegal review.'

items.label: Non-representation disclaimer placed visibly above submit button
Opposing party field set as mandatory for conflict check screening
